evidence: The commenter reported professional deployment of FlightGear for multi-window trainer visuals.

evidence_sources.author: phugoid
evidence_sources.excerpt: We used FlightGear in a master-slave setup: the master node simulates physics and feeds accelerations to the hydraulic platform, and the slave nodes generate out-the-window visuals for each window.

source_story_title: Show HN: I made a flight simulator, except you're just a passenger
